label: SYNTHETIC OBSERVABLE-AUGMENTED IDENTIFIABILITY DIAGNOSTIC
description: Finite-difference local-sensitivity study of the negative particle diffusivity scale factor under a voltage-only observable set versus an observable-augmented set (GITT-D rest voltages and pulse drops, EIS real and imaginary impedance, OCV-vs-SOC null control). Compared against the committed voltage-only baseline; diagnostic only.

a_priori_diffusion_scales.source: installed Chen2020 values; tau = R^2/D, f = 1/(2*pi*tau)

voltage_only.classification_rule: conjunction: combined implied rel. SE <= 0.05 AND strongest block mean |S| >= 0.05

observable_augmented.classification_rule: conjunction: combined implied rel. SE <= 0.05 AND strongest block mean |S| >= 0.05

verdict.statement: The added observables do NOT flip the recorded UNOBSERVABLE verdict under the declared aggregation rule; the parameter remains MEASURE, not CALIBRATE.

eis_positive_control.interpretation: A non-zero relative change proves the EIS simulation applies supplied parameter values. A near-zero change for the study parameter is therefore a property of the installed EIS formulation, not a harness bug.

limitations: SYNTHETIC ONLY: every curve is model-generated, not measured experimentally.
Local finite-difference sensitivity at scale factor 1.0; it is not a global identifiability proof.
The result is conditional on the declared noise assumptions in the config.
No calibration objective, registry record or dossier decision was changed.
GITT-D end-of-rest voltages approximate quasi-relaxed OCV; they are not extrapolated to infinite time.

PyBaMM 26.8.0.0 EIS does not respond to the solid particle diffusivity, although it does respond to kinetic and geometric parameters (positive control recorded); this is a verified tool limitation, not a physical conclusion about real cells.
OCV-vs-SOC is a negative control: equilibrium thermodynamics is insensitive to a transport parameter.
scientific_note: Local sensitivity diagnostic only. A well-conditioned FIM is not proof of identifiability (rule 7) and all curves are synthetic (rule 8). No calibration objective, registry record or dossier decision was changed.
